text.body: ॥ bilvāṣṭakam ॥ tridalaṃ triguṇākāraṃ trinetraṃ ca triyāyudhaṃ । trijanmapāpasaṃhāraṃ ekabilvaṃ śivārpitam ॥ 1 triśākhairbilvapatraiśca acchidraiḥ komalaiśśubhaiḥ । tava pūjāṃ kariṣyāmi eka ...॥ 2 darśanaṃ bilvavṛkṣaiśca sparśanaṃ pāpanāśanam । aghorapāpasaṃhāraṃ eka ...॥ 3 sālagrāmeṣu vipreṣu taṭāke vanakūpayoḥ । yajñakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ eka ...॥ 4 dantikoṭisahasreṣu aśvamedhaśatāni ca । koṭikanyāpradānena eka ...॥ 5 ekaṃ ca bilvapatraiśca koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet । mahādevaiśca pūjārtha eka ...॥ 6 kāśīkṣetre nivāsaṃ ca kālabhairavadarśanam । gayāprayāgame dṛṣṭvā eka ...॥ 7 umayā saha deveśaṃ vāhanaṃ nandiśaṅkaram । mucyate sarvapāpebhyo ekabilvaṃ śivārpitam ॥ 8 ॥ iti śrībilvāṣṭakam ॥ tulasī bilva nirguṇḍī apāmārgakapitthako । śamī cāmalakaṃ dūrvā aṣṭabilvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ॥ 9 ॥ityaṣṭabilvāni॥
